name: e-invoicing-tr-transport-mode-codes
title: UBL-TR transport mode codes (e-Fatura)
description: TransportModeCode values for Turkish e-documents: the eight modes with Turkish names in Kod Listeleri §1.10, plus codes 0 and 9 accepted by the UBL-TR schematron without a name in the guide.

sources.title: UBL-TR Kod Listeleri, Versiyon 1.43, Temmuz 2026 (section 1.10 Taşıma Gönderim Şekli Kodları), in UBLTR_1.2.1_Kilavuzlar.zip, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16
e-Fatura Paketi, schematron/UBL-TR_Codelist.xml (TransportModeCodeList; package history up to 2026-07-01), Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16

fields.name: name
fields.description: Turkish name from the guide. Empty for codes 0 and 9 (schematron only).

fields.name: in_schematron
fields.description: true when TransportModeCodeList accepts the code.
